five_minutes: RBI VRRR auction absorbed ₹4.61 lakh cr at 5.24% cut‑off, keeping short‑term money‑market rates anchored.
SEBI’s new FPI‑G‑sec compliance rules lower entry friction, likely boosting foreign demand for Indian sovereigns.
State‑government bond auction cleared at 7.46% for Andhra Pradesh 2035, setting a sub‑sovereign yield benchmark.
Carney flags US‑Canada tariff escalation as a cost‑inflating, growth‑dragging risk, potentially supporting USD.
Premature redemption of SGB series XII may increase gold supply, tempering gold price upside.

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: Carney warns US‑Canada tariff escalation will raise costs and dampen global growth
items.what_happened: Former Bank of England chief Mark Carney said the retaliatory tariffs between the US and Canada will come at a cost and could hurt growth.
items.why_it_matters: Higher tariffs may boost the USD as a safe‑haven and weigh on commodity demand, affecting emerging‑market risk sentiment and capital flows.
items.update_note: Carried over from yesterday with new reporting.

items.headline: US imposes import ban on Canadian alcohol and motorbikes, escalating trade tensions
items.what_happened: The United States announced an import ban on selected Canadian products, adding to the ongoing tariff dispute.
items.why_it_matters: The escalation reinforces USD upside in risk‑off trades and adds volatility to global markets, which can spill over to Indian equity and bond flows.

items.headline: SEBI eases compliance for FPIs investing only in government securities
items.what_happened: Regulatory requirements for FPIs holding solely Indian G‑sec portfolios have been relaxed, removing certain reporting thresholds.
items.why_it_matters: Lower entry friction is likely to boost foreign demand for Indian sovereigns, supporting yields and the INR through higher inflows.

items.headline: RBI launches September round of Inflation Expectations Survey of Households
items.what_happened: The RBI began its monthly survey across 19 cities to capture household inflation expectations.
items.why_it_matters: Survey outcomes will feed RBI’s forward guidance; shifts in inflation expectations can alter policy‑rate outlook, influencing the INR and bond markets.

items.headline: RBI VRRR auction absorbs ₹4.61 lakh cr at 5.24% cut‑off, anchoring short‑term rates
items.what_happened: The 1‑day VRRR auction on Sep 9 received offers of ₹4.61 lakh cr, fully accepted at a 5.24% cut‑off rate.
items.why_it_matters: Strong absorption keeps money‑market rates near 5.2%, limiting upward pressure on G‑sec yields and supporting the INR by containing liquidity spillovers.

items.headline: Money‑market volumes on Sep 8 show call‑money at 4.98% and repo at 4.58%, indicating tight liquidity
items.what_happened: Overnight segment volume was ₹6.83 lakh cr with a weighted‑average rate of 4.53%; call money averaged 4.98% and triparty repo 4.58%.
items.why_it_matters: Current short‑term rates near the policy corridor suggest limited room for RBI easing, reinforcing the current G‑sec yield curve and INR stability.

items.headline: State‑government securities auction clears full ₹3.66 bn at 7.46% yield for Andhra Pradesh 2035 issue
items.what_happened: The auction of Andhra Pradesh SGS 2035 was fully subscribed at a 7.46% coupon, with total notified amount ₹1 bn and re‑issue of 7.46% bond.
items.why_it_matters: Strong demand at 7.46% sets a benchmark for sub‑sovereign yields, influencing broader G‑sec pricing and fund allocation to state bonds.

items.headline: Premature redemption permitted for SGB 2020‑21 series XII at market price
items.what_happened: Investors may redeem SGB series XII before maturity, with redemption price set at prevailing market value.
items.why_it_matters: Potential early redemptions increase physical gold supply and may cap further upside in gold prices, affecting gold‑linked portfolios.
